name: Bishoujo Dorei Club
source:
Prestigious private school has become a nest for a gang of bad guys  "SMACKS". One day a diligent female student visits this den voluntarily. What's her aim and why she's doing it out of free will?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
名牌私立学校成了一伙坏人“SMACKS”的老巢。有一天，一位勤奋的女学生自愿来到这个书房。她的目的是什么？为什么她出于自由意志这样做？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
